name: Gästehaus Obwexer
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Obwexer is located in Tyrol, Austria, and is run as a traditional inn. Situated in a peaceful setting, it is immersed in the idyllic rural countryside of Tyrol. Guests can look forward to a traditional atmosphere accompanied by warm, down-to-earth hospitality. The surrounding landscape provides diverse opportunities for hiking and outdoor adventures. Amenities include an on-site restaurant and a welcoming lounge area. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished, and free Wi-Fi is available in public areas.
